description: Per-case heuristic stage timings supporting the mean planning times in Figure 5.

definitions.construction_seconds: Successful cases: elapsed from entry of heuristics.greedy to final insertion trace timestamp, before four refinement passes and final result conversion/validation. Failed cases: full elapsed failed construction attempt; no refinement is executed.
definitions.greedy_cumulative_search_seconds: Elapsed heuristics.greedy call, including construction, four refinement passes when construction succeeds, final result conversion and validation. No option preprocessing.
definitions.additional_refinement_and_finalization_s: greedy.seconds - greedy_construction.seconds; valid because both share the same perf_counter start in one greedy execution, as confirmed by adapter.greedy_stages. This difference includes remaining insertion-trace bookkeeping, refinement and final result conversion/validation, so is not a clean timer around refinement only. Exactly zero on all 15 failed constructions.
definitions.beam_additional_seconds: Elapsed seeded heuristics.beam call. Includes rebuilding/validating greedy seed, per-service arrangement generation, beam search, and result conversion/validation. Excludes greedy call and shared option preprocessing.
definitions.greedy_beam_cumulative_search_seconds: full.seconds = greedy.seconds + beam.seconds. Full selects the best greedy/beam candidate; beam itself retains the greedy seed. No separately timed final-selection stage.
definitions.preprocessing_seconds: complete.option_build_seconds measures builder(case,catalog): measured-catalog validation/copy, model initialization, finite-window admission interval compilation, alternatives and lookup construction. It excludes catalog JSON loading, imports, offline profiling/grid generation, exact solver, other baseline runs, saved file I/O, and physical GPU execution.
definitions.greedy_beam_with_preprocessing_seconds: full_total_seconds in cases_audit is copied from planning_timing.full_with_option_build_seconds = option_build_seconds + full.seconds. It is the sum of recorded components, not a separate end-to-end wall-clock timer.
